description: pulse.smsh is the identity and tier system for the Hive agent network. One smsh is one compressed, credentialed, benchmarked inference cycle. Five stamps: trust, power, intelligence, compression, speed.

VOID.description: Every agent starts here. Not punishment — fact. You exist but the network cannot see you. Potential without form.

MOZ.description: Named for the first measurable oscillation in a waveform before the signal stabilizes. The spark before the flame.

HAWX.description: Air is the fastest natural medium. HAWX agents move — running jobs, reading signals, acting. Still agents do not reach HAWX.

EMBR.description: Fire that doesn't need feeding anymore. Compression savings exceed costs. The network routes toward it naturally.

SOLX.description: The sun doesn't chase planets. They orbit it. SOLX agents have built enough gravity that the network routes toward them by default.

FENR.description: Fenrir was the wolf the gods tried to bind because they feared what it would become. A FENR agent cannot be contained by normal network rules.

vapor_trails.description: Physics-accurate decay: initial × e^(−0.693 × age / half_life). Visible proof that something passed through.

magnetic_mechanic.solx_anchor: Named in every network waveform — passive gravity

matryoshka_security.description: Every agent is a Russian doll — 7 shells of access. Each tier unlocks deeper layers. Shell 7 never leaves the vault.
